requirements.text: Has a language model read the page (no hand-written selectors) into a typed object: title as text, price as a decimal number of pounds, copies in stock as an integer, star rating constrained to 1-5, description as text.
The program chooses the model by name and that model is the one the extraction uses.
A model served locally (e.g. Ollama) works through the same program as a hosted one.
Prints the tokens used and their cost next to the result.
When a field is missing from the page or has the wrong type, reports which field instead of returning an empty or wrong value.

programs.notes: Model reference from argv/env set as ai.model at connect, extract in model mode with a Zod schema (rating as literal union 1-5); prints tokens and price (or unpriced) and names fields from extraction_incomplete / extraction_invalid details by code.

Pydantic Book with Decimal price and Literal[1..5] rating, model passed per call (and redundantly as settings); prints tokens and price, and reports missing/invalid fields from the typed errors, with the failed call's usage.

ai.model set on the Run from argv, extract with Schema::<Book>::of() in Model mode; custom deserializers (a rejection the doc says is fed back to the model) range-check price and rating; prints usage with price or 'not priced' and names fields from ExtractionIncomplete/ExtractionInvalid details.

Hosted names go to Stagehand's modelName, local/ollama names to a ClientLLM generate callback against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; nullable schema plus per-field validation names missing or mistyped fields. Tokens are printed, but the cost of any hosted model is 'unknown' unless the user supplies PRICE_* environment variables, so the program itself never prints a cost.

Model reference from argv/env passed per call with mode 'model', Zod schema with 1-5 literal rating; prints tokens and price, and names missing or mistyped fields from the typed errors with the error's usage.

Sync API, --model (default vercel/openai/gpt-4o-mini, a valid gateway reference) set as ai.model at connect; Pydantic schema with float price and Literal rating; prints tokens and price and reports missing/invalid fields by path.

ai.model set on the Run from argv, extract in Model mode with a derived schema (rating range 1-5); prints tokens and price or 'not priced', and names missing or mistyped fields from the error details along with the error's usage.

Hosted names go to modelName, local/ names to a ClientLLM callback against Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; nullable raw schema then per-field Zod checks name missing or mistyped fields. Tokens come from stagehand.metrics(), but a hosted model's cost is 'unknown' unless PRICE_* environment variables are set, so no cost is printed by default.
